C4 Coherency Transactions on the Read Address and Write Address Channels
C4.9 Evict transactions


C4.9    Evict transactions

                    This section defines the state changes associated with the Evict transaction group that are issued on the AW channel.


C4.9.1      Evict

               An Evict transaction indicates that a cache line has been evicted from a master’s local cache. There is no data
                        transfer associated with an Evict transaction. An Evict transaction must only be used in a shareable memory region.

                      Note
               An Evict transaction is only used by a master that supports a snoop filter.


                    Table C4-28 shows the expected cache line state changes for the Evict transaction.
